title: Returned-Payment-Fee Relief Size and the Plan's Late-Fee Record (PracticePay)
content:
**Rule.** For a returned-payment-fee relief on a PracticePay Patient Financing plan, the returned-payment-fee relief size follows the plan's late-fee record: when the late-fee entry that names the due date the payment that came back was credited toward already carries a waiver entry, so that the same missed payment has been relieved once, the relief size is the part of the returned-payment fee above 5.00 USD, never below 0.00 and never more than 12.00 USD; when that late-fee entry carries no waiver entry, or no late-fee entry names that due date but the plan shows a late fee dated within the last 6 months, the relief size is the part of the returned-payment fee above 5.00 USD, never below 0.00; in every other case the relief size is the returned-payment fee in full; a window of the last N months here covering entries dated fewer than N whole months before the relief date, a month being whole once the relief date's day of the month has reached the entry's day of the month.

## Decision table

| Late-fee entry naming the due date the returned payment was credited toward | Late fee on the plan within the last 6 months | Relief size |
|---|---|---|
| exists and carries a waiver entry | any | fee less 5.00, never below 0.00, never more than 12.00 |
| exists, no waiver entry | any | fee less 5.00, never below 0.00 |
| none | yes | fee less 5.00, never below 0.00 |
| none | no | the fee in full |

A payment that came back without having been credited toward a due date has no such late-fee entry; only the 6-month late-fee record then matters.

## Figures (hypothetical fee of 20.00 USD)

- Same-due-date late fee already relieved: 20.00 less 5.00 is 15.00, held to 12.00.
- Same-due-date late fee not relieved: 15.00.
- No same-due-date late fee, but a late fee 4 months ago: 15.00.
- No late fee in the last 6 months and none for that due date: 20.00.
